name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine: Sudan, South Sudan
summary: FEWS NET sees risk of Famine in Darfur and South Kordofan; no area classified as Famine as of 10 Nov
state: FEWS NET's latest Sudan update, covering September 2026 to January 2027, says the risk of Famine has expanded to parts of South Darfur, including Sharg Aj-Jabal, and persists in North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling. Acute malnutrition passed the Famine threshold in two of four assessed camps, which FEWS NET says does not establish a Famine classification. Its Sudan page still showed no area classified as Famine on 10 Nov.
for_you: Famine risk is concentrated in Sudan and South Sudan. There is no direct effect on UK food supplies; aid agencies warn that conflict and funding gaps are the main drivers.
rubric_hit: 'Risk of Famine' alerts from FEWS NET for Sudan; no IPC Phase 5 Famine classification

sources.title: FEWS NET — Sudan: risk of Famine expands to parts of South Darfur

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
